description: This file defines the MappingContext interface for configuring mapping behavior in a connectivity framework. It specifies methods for retrieving mapping engine information, options, conditions, and serialization to JSON, along with nested classes for JSON field definitions.

classes.name: MappingContext
classes.description: An interface defining the configuration for message mapping, including methods for retrieving engine info, options, conditions, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: MappingContext.JsonFields
classes.description: A container class for predefined JSON field definitions related to MappingContext configuration.

methods.name: getMappingEngine
methods.description: Returns the name or class of the mapping engine used for message transformation.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Deprecated method returning mapping options as string key-value pairs.

methods.name: getOptionsAsJson
methods.description: Returns all configuration options as a JsonObject.

methods.name: getIncomingConditions
methods.description: Retrieves conditions that must be validated before processing incoming messages.

methods.name: getOutgoingConditions
methods.description: Retrieves conditions that must be validated before processing outgoing messages.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the MappingContext to a JsonObject with non-hidden fields.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the MappingContext to a JsonObject with specified schema version and field selector.
